compiled_state.title: As a repo admin, I can configure GitHub Rulesets for session-* branches and Sprint Phase A validates the configuration before dispatch
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Add a Phase A preflight check that validates GitHub Rulesets for session-* branches are correctly configured, and document the one-time admin setup steps in INSTALL.md.

**Why**: The unified architecture requires that direct pushes to session branches are rejected (enforcing sub-branch-to-session PR flow) and that per-branch-review.yml is listed as a required status check. Without the preflight, operators can start a sprint in a misconfigured repo and encounter silent failures mid-sprint.

**Scope**:
- IN: New preflight script (or inline in sprint SKILL.md Phase A) that asserts: (a) at least one Ruleset exists matching the session-* pattern, (b) the pinned dso.review.check_name (per-branch-review / WORKFLOW_NAME) appears in required_status_checks.checks, (c) required_linear_history=false; exits non-zero with an actionable error message + link to INSTALL.md on failure; add INSTALL.md section documenting one-time Ruleset setup (admin:write permission, gh api commands, required settings)
- OUT: Creating the Ruleset programmatically at runtime (admin setup is the operator's responsibility); Ruleset enforcement at push time (GitHub enforces); per-branch-review.yml itself (S1)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, Sprint Phase A preflight checks: (a) a Ruleset matching session-* exists, (b) dso.review.check_name appears in required_status_checks.checks, (c) required_linear_history=false; exits non-zero with actionable error + INSTALL.md link on any failure; verified by running preflight against a repo with a missing/misconfigured Ruleset
  ← Satisfies: "Phase A preflight asserts Ruleset exists and matches session-*, pinned check name appears in required_status_checks.checks, required_linear_history is false" (SC4)
- When this story is complete, INSTALL.md documents the one-time Ruleset setup steps (admin:write required for setup; runtime CI does NOT require admin permissions; gh api commands provided)
  ← Satisfies: SC4 operational readiness; Ruleset provisioning ownership (Operational Constraint)
- When this story is complete, an attempted direct push to a session branch is rejected with the expected branch-protection error (verified empirically in representative sprint)
  ← Satisfies: SC4 "Rulesets on session-* reject direct pushes"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Security] Ruleset admin permissions: one-time setup requires admin:write. Runtime CI must NOT require admin permissions — the preflight uses read-only gh api calls only.
- [Maintainability] Pinned dso.review.check_name (from dso-config.conf) must be consistent across: per-branch-review.yml (name: field), Rulesets required_status_checks value, and Phase A preflight assertion. The preflight reads the config and compares — it does not hardcode the name.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
